title: Harden SkinnedMeshRenderer binding compatibility and animated bounds policy
description:
## Summary
The runtime skinned renderer must consume the same authoritative skeleton that its CreatureRig was built from, and its animated visibility/bounds behavior must have an explicit contract. Equal bone count alone is insufficient for safe indexed binding.

## Scope
- Require the supplied rest skeleton to structurally match the rig's authoritative SkeletonSnapshot before binding.
- Preserve one indexed bone order across rig transforms, bindposes, bone weights, and the renderer bone array.
- Add regression coverage for same-count but structurally different skeletons.
- Define and validate an animated bounds/culling policy for valid poses; do not blindly force updateWhenOffscreen without evidence.
- Keep build/rebind work separate from the steady-state animation path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Bind rejects same-count skeletons whose IDs, parent topology, semantic metadata, rest frames, segment state, or attachment structure differ from the built rig.
- A successful bind uses one authoritative skeleton ordering for bindposes, weights, and renderer bones.
- Real generated-creature tests cover the compatibility gate.
- Valid exaggerated poses have a documented and validated renderer bounds/culling behavior.
- No per-frame binding, weight authoring, mesh copying, or skeleton recapture is introduced.

## Implementation
The binding adapter now compares the captured supplied skeleton against `CreatureRig.RestSkeleton` using the existing structural `SkeletonSnapshot.HasSameBoneOrder` contract in addition to the bone-count guard. This is a small, fail-fast boundary correction that prevents a same-count index mismatch from reaching Unity. A focused runtime regression was added for a same-count skeleton with a different root position.

## Validation
Source-level validation is complete for the compatibility guard and regression fixture. Unity execution remains required for the regression test and for the animated bounds/culling portion of the task.

## Blockers
Animated bounds/culling behavior is Unity-gated.

## Provenance
Created from the 2026-09-09 audit-synthesis hidden finding F-01. The broader pose-space and reusable-buffer work remains under TSK-0200; performance benchmarking remains under TSK-0134.

comments.body: Safe source fix landed: CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bind now rejects a supplied rest skeleton unless it structurally matches the authoritative CreatureRig.RestSkeleton via SkeletonSnapshot.HasSameBoneOrder. Added a focused same-count/different-rest-frame regression. Unity execution remains the validation gate; animated bounds policy is still open.
